rupa.t: Holding a blade of grass between my teeth, I beg again and again that birth after birth I may become the dust of the lotus feet of Śrīla Rūpa Gosvāmī.
rupa.s: Śrīla Raghunātha dāsa Gosvāmī, Śrī Dāna-keli-cintāmaṇi, text 175.

w: shelter at his own lotus feet
rupa.t: When will Śrīla Rūpa Gosvāmī Prabhupāda, who has established within this material world the mission to fulfill the desire of Lord Caitanya, give me shelter under his lotus feet?
rupa.s: Narottama dāsa Ṭhākura, Prema-bhakti-candrikā, Maṅgalācaraṇa, text 2.

rupa.t: On the strength of the service I have done to the dust of his lotus feet, I am able to always reside, even in times of trouble, by the shore of Rādhā-kuṇḍa at the foot of Govardhana Hill. Protected by his dear associates, I chant and hear the holy names of Śrī Śrī Rādhā-Mukunda, which defeat the sweetest nectar. I pray that Śrīla Rūpa Gosvāmī may always protect me.
rupa.s: Śrīla Raghunātha dāsa Gosvāmī, Stavāvalī, Abhīṣṭa-sūcanam, text 13.

w: unto the person whose dear friend was Śrīla Svarūpa Dāmodara Gosvāmī
who was very dear to Him (Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu)
unto the replica of His personal ecstatic love
who exactly followed the principles of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu
who describes the pastimes of Lord Kṛṣṇa
rupa.t: Indeed, Śrīla Rūpa Gosvāmī, whose dear friend was Svarūpa Dāmodara, was the exact replica of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, and he was very, very dear to the Lord. Being the embodiment of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu’s ecstatic love, Rūpa Gosvāmī was naturally very beautiful. He very carefully followed the principles enunciated by the Lord, and he was a competent person to explain properly the pastimes of Lord Kṛṣṇa. Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu expanded His mercy to Śrīla Rūpa Gosvāmī just so he could render service by writing transcendental literatures.
rupa.s: Kṛṣṇadāsa Kavirāja Gosvāmī, Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 19.121.

w: talks about the pastimes of Śrī Kṛṣṇa
the creation of this cosmic manifestation
rupa.t: Before the creation of this cosmic manifestation, the Lord enlightened the heart of Lord Brahmā with the details of the creation and manifested the Vedic knowledge. In exactly the same way, the Lord, being anxious to revive the Vṛndāvana pastimes of Lord Kṛṣṇa, impregnated the heart of Rūpa Gosvāmī with spiritual potency. By this potency, Śrīla Rūpa Gosvāmī could revive the activities of Kṛṣṇa in Vṛndāvana, activities almost lost to memory. In this way, He spread Kṛṣṇa consciousness throughout the world.
rupa.s: Kṛṣṇadāsa Kavirāja Gosvāmī, Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 19.1.

sanatana.t: I was unwilling to drink the nectar of devotional service possessed of renunciation, but Sanātana Gosvāmī, out of his causeless mercy, made me drink it, even though I was otherwise unable to do so. Therefore he is an ocean of mercy. He is very compassionate to fallen souls like me, and thus it is my duty to offer my respectful obeisances unto his lotus feet.
sanatana.s: Śrīla Raghunātha dāsa Gosvāmī, Śrī Vilāpa-kusumāñjali, text 6.

w: the elder brother of Śrīla Rūpa Gosvāmī
by the mellows of inner love of Kṛṣṇa
a great or very deep lake
to those acquainted with the science of devotional service
sanatana.t: Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, the elder brother of Śrīla Rūpa Gosvāmī, was a most important minister in the government of Hussain Shah, the ruler of Bengal, and he was considered a most brilliant gem in that assembly. He possessed all the opulences of a royal position, but he gave up everything just to accept the youthful goddess of renunciation. Although he externally appeared to be a mendicant who had renounced everything, he was filled with the pleasure of devotional service within his heart. Thus he can be compared to a deep lake covered with moss. He was the object of pleasure for all the devotees who knew the science of devotional service.

w: of the living being, the soul
sanatana.t: Let us bow down to Śrī Sanātana Gosvāmī, who gave up the post of minister in the kingdom of Gauḍa to take shelter at the feet of Lord Gaurāṅga, and who taught us the truth about the nature of the soul.

Countless souls in this world become supremely blessed by bowing their heads to the dust of the lotus feet of Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī. His heart is soft with compassion, and he alone is the shelter, day after day, even for a fool like me.

Eternal glories to Sākara Mallika, who is filled with spiritual love, who is learned in Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam, who has turned from the happiness of the world of birth and death, who tastes the sweetness of devotional service, who is the leader of the devotees, and who is like Śukadeva Gosvāmī in this world!

w: under the shelter of the lotus feet
raghunatha-das.t: Śrīla Raghunātha dāsa Gosvāmī was one of the most dear servants of Lord Caitanya Mahāprabhu. He left all his material possessions to surrender completely unto the Lord and live at His lotus feet.
raghunatha-das.s: Kṛṣṇadāsa Kavirāja Gosvāmī, Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Ādi-līlā 10.91.

w: of Śrī Rūpa and Śrī Sanātana
raghunatha-das.t: He is bathed in the waves of the nectarean river of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu's mercy, he is most dear to Śrī Rūpa and Śrī Sanātana, he is full of fatherly affection for Śrī Jīva, and he lives on the shore of Śrī Rādhā-kuṇḍa, delighting in the nectar of the holy name. To him, Śrī Raghunātha dāsa Gosvāmī, the ocean of mercy, I bow down incessantly.
I offer my respects to my master Śrī Raghunātha, known as Dāsa Gosvāmī, in whose life and sādhana the gradual dawning of bhāva, ecstatic divine love, can be clearly seen.

Raghunātha dāsa Gosvāmī wept day and night. His body and mind were burning, and at times his limbs became grey with dust. His eyes had grown blind from fasting, and his own body, worn out by the pain of separation, became a burden to him.

w: of those two masters (Rūpa and Sanātana)
raghunatha-das.t: May he protect me who, full of mercy, showed me a father's love; who is renowned as a brother to those two masters, Rūpa and Sanātana; who is dear to the saints; and who shines in this world, famed as Raghunātha dāsa.

w: at the lotus feet of Lord Govinda
the lotus feet of Lord Govinda
raghunatha-bhatta.t: Raghunātha Bhaṭṭa surrendered fully at the lotus feet of Lord Govinda, and those lotus feet became his life and soul. Raghunātha Bhaṭṭa ordered his disciples to construct a temple for Govinda. He prepared various ornaments for Govinda, including a flute and shark-shaped earrings.
raghunatha-bhatta.s: Kṛṣṇadāsa Kavirāja Gosvāmī, Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 13.130–131.

w: in the assembly of Rūpa, Sanātana and other Vaiṣṇavas
raghunatha-bhatta.t: When reciting Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam in the company of Rūpa and Sanātana, Raghunātha Bhaṭṭa would be overwhelmed with ecstatic love for Kṛṣṇa. When he recited or heard about the beauty and sweetness of Kṛṣṇa, he would be overwhelmed with ecstatic love and become oblivious to everything.
raghunatha-bhatta.s: Kṛṣṇadāsa Kavirāja Gosvāmī, Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 13.126, 129.

w: he passed the whole day and night
raghunatha-bhatta.t: Raghunātha Bhaṭṭa would neither hear nor speak about anything of the material world. He would simply discuss Kṛṣṇa and worship the Lord day and night. He would not listen to blasphemy of a Vaiṣṇava, nor would he listen to talk of a Vaiṣṇava's misbehavior. He knew only that everyone was engaged in Kṛṣṇa's service; he did not understand anything else.
raghunatha-bhatta.s: Kṛṣṇadāsa Kavirāja Gosvāmī, Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 13.132–133.

raghunatha-bhatta.t: I offer my obeisances to him who bears the name Raghunātha Bhaṭṭa Gosvāmī, whose relishing of Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam in Vraja brought joy to all the saintly.

jiva.t: Full of compassion, Śrīla Jīva Gosvāmī revealed the supreme and incomparable truth of devotional service, hidden in all the scriptures and hard for the people of this world to reach. He also described the many pastimes of Śrī Kṛṣṇa. Having taken shelter of him, I eternally bow down to the blessed feet of Śrī Jīva Gosvāmī.
I worship my master Śrī Jīva Gosvāmī, by whose grace the meaning of Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam became as simple and clear for everyone as an āmalaka fruit lying on the palm of one's hand.
jiva.s: Hare Kṛṣṇa Ācārya, Bāla-toṣaṇī (commentary on Hari-nāmāmṛta-vyākaraṇa).

jiva.t: Again and again I offer my obeisances to Śrī Jīva Gosvāmī, who is lovingly attached to the feet of Śrī Rūpa, who lives in Vraja, and who bestows spiritual bliss even upon utter fools. The Deity of Rādhā-Dāmodara was made by Śrī Rūpa with his own hands and given to Jīva Gosvāmī by him, the ocean of mercy.

v: kṛṣṇaṁ sa jīvaḥ prabhur astu me gatiḥ
jiva.t: May Śrīla Jīva Gosvāmī be my shelter. With the nectar of his words he revealed the Supreme Lord Śrī Kṛṣṇa, whose spiritual effulgence had been hidden by mental speculation, false logic and Māyāvāda.
jiva.s: Śrīla Baladeva Vidyābhūṣaṇa, Govinda-bhāṣya, opening verse.

w: for whom the feet of Govinda are everything
on the order of Śrī Rūpa Gosvāmī
gopal-bhatta.t: I bow down to Śrīla Gopāla Bhaṭṭa Gosvāmī, for whom the lotus feet of Śrī Govinda-deva are everything, and who, following the order of Śrī Rūpa Gosvāmī, revealed to the world a distinct service to the Lord — to Śrī Rādhā-ramaṇa, the beloved of Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī. Rādhā-ramaṇa is the very same Govinda whom the expert Śrīla Rūpa Gosvāmī had earlier manifested with great devotion.

w: by friendship with Śrī Rūpa Gosvāmī
gopal-bhatta.t: I bow down to Śrīla Gopāla Bhaṭṭa Gosvāmī. His heart is completely flooded with transcendental love for Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, and all his endeavours and deeds are marked and inspired by brotherly friendship and cooperation with Śrīla Rūpa Gosvāmī. The Deity of Śrī Rādhā-ramaṇa is the one source and meaning of his life. Merciful by nature, he fulfils the innermost desires of those who worship and serve him.

Śrī Gopāla Bhaṭṭa Gosvāmī was one of the great and exalted branches of the tree of Lord Caitanya. He always engaged in discourses about love of Godhead in the company of Rūpa Gosvāmī and Sanātana Gosvāmī.
gopal-bhatta.s: Kṛṣṇadāsa Kavirāja Gosvāmī, Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Ādi-līlā 10.105.

w: the shelter of those who bow down
gopal-bhatta.t: Śrīmad Gopāla Bhaṭṭa is the best of masters, an ocean of mercy and the friend of fallen souls. I constantly offer my respects to his lotus feet, the shelter of all who bow before him. Śrīman Caitanya-deva, supremely kind-hearted and full of boundless compassion, taught him the service of the lotus feet of Śrī Rādhā-Kṛṣṇa.
